label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_02
text: Ready to sign up for your official match?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_reception_01
text: You’re [VAR 0x0100(0000)], yes?

label: sdc02_0180_reception_02
text: Let me get your Championship match set up.\nThis will just take a moment.

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...you said you
and
Kieran
are
friends,
right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_select_01
text: Yeah!

label: sdc02_0180_select_02
text: Well, sorta...

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_04
text: Huh. No kidding.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_05
text: No need to be shy about it. Friend drama’s just\npart of life at your age.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_06
text: Here’s the Drayster take: I liked Kieran better\nwhen his hair was down.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_07
text:
He used to be this quiet little guy. Trembled like
a leaf. Had all the spine of a Wimpod.\c
He’d hide behind Carmine if you so much as
breathed too loud. But I tell you what...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_08
text: When it came to Pokémon battling, I never saw\nso much joy in anyone’s eyes as in his![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_09
text: But then, outta nowhere, he...changed.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_10
text: Now he’s relentless—pushes himself, pushes\neveryone around him...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_11
text: Nothing good’s gonna come of this. Someone’s\ngotta snap him out of it.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_12
text: I tried but couldn’t do it. Guess I’ve gone soft\nfrom the lazy life. So now I guess it falls to you.\r\nSorry, bud.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_reception_03
text: Sorry to keep you waiting! Everything’s ready.

label: sdc02_0180_reception_04
text: Are you ready to battle Kieran, the BB League\nChampion?

label: sdc02_0180_reception_05
text: Please come back when you’re ready.

label: sdc02_0180_reception_06
text: Understood.\c\nYour Championship match will begin soon.\nPlease make sure you are ready.

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_13
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Well, it’s all up to you now,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0180_dragonbb_14
text: Me and the other Elite Three will be cheering for\nyou.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

text: A Championship match is about to begin at the\nbattle court near the entrance to the academy.

label: sdc02_0180_announce_03

text: What happens next with Kieran and the League\nClub is up to you. Good luck, bud.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
